weights_fit.method: calibration/fit.py: logistic regression on the seven pillar scores, one row per token as scored at its trigger, split forward in time (last 30% held out). Coefficients clamped at zero, renormalised to sum to 1 and rounded to two places (LogisticModel.deployable_weights).
weights_fit.label: max_multiple_6h

phase_0_exit_criteria.explanation: triggered=279 complete_social=0/300 dead_per_survivor=1.2/20 -> NOT met, keep collecting

momentum.definition: The shape of the last hour rather than the level of the last day: the buy/sell split over 1h and 24h, 1h volume against the 6h rate, and the per-window price change. Stored raw and derived at read time.
momentum.caveat: Weight 0.00 in the composite (fitted-v1): no snapshot the weights were fitted on carried these fields, so no fit has weighed them yet. A ratio between two nested windows reads a token's age until the longer window has filled -- and pins at the window ratio when every trade falls in the shorter one -- so those components are dropped for a token younger than the longer window rather than scored. The buy/sell split is a ratio inside one window and does not saturate.

mindshare.definition: Share of the attention observed across one measurement universe: 24h transactions, 24h volume and DexScreener boost spend, each as a share of the universe total, averaged over the components that resolved. It is on-chain and paid attention, not social mentions.
mindshare.caveat: The universe is whatever the collector polled -- tokens reach it by being boosted or profiled on DexScreener -- so it is a biased sample and shares from different universes are not comparable. Weighted 0.08 in the composite (fitted-v1); it reads 24h volume, as the on-chain pillar does, so read the two weights together.

headline_warning: Phase 0 -- collection only. The scoring weights (fitted-v1) were fitted on 190 tokens, before Phase 0's gate was met. On the 82 that triggered next they ranked a 1.5x within 6h with AUC 0.67 (95% CI 0.52-0.83; 0.50 is a coin flip) -- a sample too small to establish an edge. No edge has been established, so nothing on this page is a prediction or a recommendation.

calibration.explanation: Phase 0 has not finished collecting, so no edge can be claimed. triggered=315 complete_social=0/300 dead_per_survivor=1.5/20 -> NOT met, keep collecting. Until this is met, every score the screener emits -- whatever weights are in force -- is a logged observation and must not be read as a prediction.
calibration.label: max_multiple_6h

backtest.verdict: 304 tokens, 71 reached max_multiple_6h >= 1.5x -- a base rate of 23.4% [18.9%, 28.4%]. Phase 0's gate is NOT met (0/300 triggered tokens with a complete social series, 1.5/20 dead per survivor), so nothing below is a calibration and no weight in prompts/score.md may be changed on it. Features that separated out of sample and survived age stratification: top10_ex_lp_pct, holder_count. Treat them as leads to collect against, not as a measured edge.

published_base_rates.note: Graduation is roughly a $69k market cap, and most graduates still round to zero. The screener's job is to beat a ~2% base rate, not to find winners.

trigger.rule: Every token is snapshotted once, the first time it crosses $250k market cap or 500 holders. The same rule applies to every token: the sample is lifecycle-matched by construction.
